name: Turn articles into LinkedIn, X thread and newsletter copy with fact and length checks

parameters.content:
## Article to LinkedIn post, X thread and newsletter blurb

### How it works
Paste one or more article URLs. The workflow downloads each page and extracts the readable article (title, headings, paragraphs) with plain JavaScript, no scraping service. Pages with too little text, such as paywalls or JavaScript-only sites, are reported instead of sent to the AI.

Any OpenAI-compatible model (Google Gemini free tier by default) writes a LinkedIn post, an X thread, a newsletter subject and blurb, and key points in your voice.

A quality gate then checks the copy:
- **Fact check:** every number in the copy must appear in the article, otherwise the pack is marked `needs_review`.
- **X limits:** posts are measured the way X counts them (links = 23, emoji = 2), long posts are split at sentence boundaries and numbered 1/n.
- **Length:** LinkedIn and newsletter limits are enforced and the article link is added.

Each article ends as a downloadable Markdown content pack. Nothing is posted.

### Setup
1. Get a free API key at aistudio.google.com.
2. Create a **Header Auth** credential (Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer YOUR_KEY`) and select it in **AI write content pack**.
3. In **Content settings** add your URLs, brand name, audience and voice. Click **Execute workflow**.

### Customization
Change `llm_base_url`/`llm_model` for Groq, OpenAI or Ollama. Replace the Manual Trigger with an RSS Feed Trigger, or send the pack to Google Docs, Notion or Slack for review.

Need more formats, a content calendar and scheduled posting? See the Relaybrook Content Repurposing Pack at relaybrook.bytesell.app.

## 1. Fetch and extract articles
Invalid or repeated URLs are skipped. Pages under `min_article_words` (paywalls, JS-only sites) are reported, not sent to the AI.

## 2. Write the copy
One AI call per article. The article is treated as untrusted data and the model is told to use only its facts.

## 3. Quality gate and export
Numbers are checked against the article, X posts are split and numbered, lengths enforced. Each article becomes a Markdown file.

assignments.value: founders and marketers at small B2B companies

assignments.name: brand_voice
assignments.value: clear, practical, friendly, no hype or buzzwords
